trophies.name: Leonida Legend
trophies.description: Earn every other trophy in Grand Theft Auto VI.
trophies.guide: The Platinum unlocks automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned. There is no shortcut: work through the story, the heists, the collectibles and the activities in this guide, and save the missable Positive Mental Attitude for a manual save before its mission. The roadmap section orders the whole run so nothing is left behind.

trophies.name: King of Leonida
trophies.description: Complete the main story of Grand Theft Auto VI.
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission as Jason and Lucia, from the prologue through the final mission. The story is linear, so you cannot miss this by playing normally; side content is optional. Expect roughly 35 to 50 hours for the story alone, and keep a save before the final mission if you want to mop up afterwards.

trophies.name: 100 Percent
trophies.description: Achieve 100% completion in Grand Theft Auto VI.
trophies.guide: 100% means the story plus every checklist item the game counts: all heists, all Strangers & Freaks missions, all hidden packages, all stunt jumps, all street races, all properties and the activity sets. Use this guide's checklist to tick each set off, and check the in-game Stats page to see which category is still short.

trophies.name: Heist Master
trophies.description: Complete every heist in Grand Theft Auto VI.
trophies.guide: Heists unlock as the story progresses and each has setup missions first. Do every setup and the finale for each heist; the trophy pops after the last finale. Heists can be replayed, so a failed approach never locks you out, but the optional objectives are worth doing for the extra payout.

trophies.name: Collector
trophies.description: Find every hidden package in Leonida.
trophies.guide: Hidden packages are tucked across Leonida: rooftops, alleyways, the docks, the swamps and the islands. There are 50 in total. Grab the Treasure Hunter trophy for your first one, then follow the district-by-district route in the guide notes and check each area off as you clear it.

trophies.name: Property Mogul
trophies.description: Own every purchasable property in Leonida.
trophies.guide: Buy every property on the in-game real estate site, from cheap safehouses to the big businesses. Properties unlock gradually as the story opens new districts, and the expensive ones need heist money, so do this late. Each property also gives a weekly income, which helps the Big Shot trophy.

trophies.name: Street King
trophies.description: Win every street race in Leonida.
trophies.guide: Street races appear at night in Vice City and the surrounding towns; talk to the race contact to see the list. Win each one at least once. Upgrade a fast car and learn the corners — the later races add traffic and police attention. Replays are unlimited, so keep retrying a race until you take first place.

trophies.name: Vice City Veteran
trophies.guide: Strangers & Freaks missions are marked with a question mark on the map and appear as you explore and progress the story. Some only appear at certain times of day or after a specific story mission, so revisit districts between story chapters. Finish all of them for the trophy.

trophies.name: Daredevil
trophies.description: Complete every stunt jump in Leonida.
trophies.guide: Stunt jumps are ramps scattered around Leonida, marked when you drive near one at speed. Hit each ramp fast enough to land the jump; a failed landing does not count, so retry until the game registers it. A fast bike makes the trickier jumps easier, and the map marks jumps you have already cleared.

trophies.name: Welcome to Leonida
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy: finish the opening prologue mission, which teaches movement, driving and the switch between Jason and Lucia. It takes about 20 minutes. The trophy pops when the prologue ends and the open world unlocks.

trophies.name: Partners in Crime
trophies.description: Complete your first mission as Jason and Lucia together.
trophies.guide: Early story trophy: play the first mission that has Jason and Lucia working as a pair. Follow the on-screen prompts to switch between them when the game asks. The trophy pops at the end of that mission.

trophies.name: Out of the Past
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing the first chapter. Play the chapter's missions in order; none of them can be missed, and a failed mission can be retried from the checkpoint. The trophy pops when the chapter's final mission ends.

trophies.name: A New Leaf
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing the second chapter. It covers the missions where Jason and Lucia set up their first real operation in Vice City. Play through in order and the trophy pops at the chapter's end.

trophies.name: The Big Score
trophies.description: Pull off your first major heist.
trophies.guide: Complete the setup missions for the first major heist, then the finale itself. The setup teaches the planning board and crew picks; choose a balanced crew and follow the plan. The trophy pops when the finale ends and the crew splits the take.

trophies.name: No Turning Back
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing the third chapter, where the stakes rise and the crew's plans start to unravel. Play the chapter's missions in order; the trophy pops at the final mission's end.

trophies.name: Family Business
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing the fourth chapter. This chapter leans on Lucia's connections and Jason's past catching up with him. Complete the missions in order and the trophy pops at the chapter's end.

trophies.name: Trust No One
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing the fifth chapter, where betrayals come to light. The missions are longer and harder here, so stock up on armour and ammo first. The trophy pops when the chapter's final mission ends.

trophies.name: The Long Way Home
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing the last mission of the game. It is the longest mission in the story, so go in with full health, armour and your best weapons. The trophy pops during the ending sequence, right before the credits.

trophies.name: Clean Getaway
trophies.description: Escape a 5-star wanted level during a heist finale.
trophies.guide: During any heist finale, build up to a 5-star wanted level, then lose the police and reach the getaway point without being caught. A fast car and the back roads out of the city help; avoid the main highways where roadblocks appear. The trophy pops once the wanted level clears inside the mission.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Keep a positive attitude when things go south.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE. During the mid-story standoff mission, when the dialogue choice appears, pick the calm and positive option instead of escalating. If you pick the aggressive line, the moment passes and the trophy is gone for that playthrough, so make a manual save before starting the mission. There is no mission replay for this choice.

trophies.name: First Blood
trophies.guide: Unmissable in practice: defeat any enemy in combat, which happens naturally in the prologue. Any weapon works, and the trophy pops the moment the first enemy goes down.

trophies.name: Sharpshooter
trophies.guide: Land 50 headshots across any mode of play; the counter is cumulative. Aim for the head in shootouts and use a rifle with a scope for distance shots. It builds up naturally over the story, and a quiet stretch at the shooting range finishes it off.

trophies.name: Trigger Happy
trophies.guide: Fire 10,000 rounds in total, across all weapons. This counts every bullet, so it accumulates fast in shootouts and heists. If you are short at the end, spend a few minutes at the shooting range with an automatic weapon and it will pop.

trophies.name: Armed and Dangerous
trophies.guide: Visit any Ammu-Nation store once it unlocks and buy any weapon. The cheapest pistol is enough. The trophy pops at the moment of purchase.

trophies.name: Fully Loaded
trophies.description: Own every weapon type at once.
trophies.guide: Own one weapon of every type at the same time: pistol, shotgun, SMG, assault rifle, sniper rifle, heavy weapon, thrown weapon and melee weapon. Buy the cheapest of each type at Ammu-Nation and keep them in your inventory; selling one breaks the set, so check the weapon wheel before counting it done.

trophies.name: Wheelman
trophies.guide: Drive a total of 500 miles across all vehicles; the counter is cumulative and runs in the background. Story missions and free roam cover most of it, and a long highway cruise in a fast car finishes the rest. Check the Stats page to see your mileage.

trophies.name: Getaway Driver
trophies.guide: Build a 4-star wanted level, then break line of sight and stay out of the police search cone until it clears. Tunnels, the swamps and the back roads break pursuit fastest; avoid the minimap's blue and red cones. The trophy pops the moment the wanted level drops to zero.

trophies.name: Smooth Criminal
trophies.guide: Build a 5-star wanted level, then lose the police completely. At 5 stars the army joins the hunt, so use the swamp waterways or a fast boat to break the search, and stay out of the cones until the level clears. The trophy pops when the wanted level hits zero.

trophies.name: Street Racer
trophies.guide: Find a street race at night in Vice City and take first place. Any car can win the early races, but a tuned sports car makes it comfortable. The trophy pops at the finish line.

trophies.name: Top Gun
trophies.guide: Take any plane or helicopter and fly underneath a bridge. The big highway bridges over the bay are the easiest targets: line up low, keep the aircraft level and pass under the span. The trophy pops the moment you clear it.

trophies.name: Deep Diver
trophies.description: Dive to the bottom of the ocean.
trophies.guide: Swim or take a submersible down to the seabed off the Leonida coast. The deepest spot is the trench east of the islands; dive straight down until the game registers the depth. Bring full lung capacity or a scuba tank so you can get back up.

trophies.name: Gone Fishin'
trophies.guide: Buy a fishing rod from a bait shop, find a fishing spot on a pier or boat, cast the line and reel in when the fish bites. The first catch can be any fish; the trophy pops when it lands in the boat.

trophies.name: Big Game Hunter
trophies.guide: Take a rifle into the swamps or the forests north of Vice City and hunt any animal. Aim for a clean shot and the trophy pops when the animal is down. Deer and boar are the most common early targets.

trophies.name: Animal Lover
trophies.guide: Walk up to any dog in the world and use the interact prompt to pet it. Dogs hang around houses, parks and the beach. The trophy pops after the petting animation finishes.

trophies.name: Beach Bum
trophies.description: Spend a day at the beach.
trophies.guide: Go to Vice Beach and stay there from morning until night without leaving the sand. Swim, sunbathe or just walk the boardwalk; the game tracks your time on the beach. The trophy pops when the in-game clock passes a full day on the beach.

trophies.name: Night Owl
trophies.description: Stay out past midnight in Vice City.
trophies.guide: Be out on the streets of Vice City after midnight. Just keep playing past 00:00 in-game time; the trophy pops shortly after midnight while you are outside. It is easiest to earn during a night mission or a late street race.

trophies.name: Party Animal
trophies.guide: Walk into any nightclub in Vice City once they open in the story. You do not need to buy anything; just step through the door and stay a moment. The trophy pops inside the club.

trophies.name: High Roller
trophies.guide: Win a total of $10,000 at the casino, across any games. Blackjack with basic strategy is the steadiest route, and the slots can spike it in one spin. The counter is cumulative, so small wins add up; save before a big bet and reload if you lose the pot.

trophies.name: Hole in One
trophies.description: Score a hole in one at golf.
trophies.guide: Play golf at the Leonida Golf Club and sink a hole in one. Par-3 holes are the only realistic chance: pick the shortest one, aim straight, use a full-power shot with a touch of backspin, and retry the hole until it drops. It is luck plus repetition, so keep replaying the par-3.

trophies.name: Home Sweet Home
trophies.guide: Buy any safehouse from the in-game real estate site once it unlocks. The cheapest apartment is enough. The trophy pops when the purchase completes, and the safehouse becomes a save point.

trophies.name: New Wheels
trophies.guide: Buy any car from an in-game dealership or car site. The cheapest car counts. The trophy pops when the purchase completes and the car is delivered to your garage.

trophies.name: House Hunter
trophies.guide: Buy any three properties from the real estate site. Safehouses, apartments and businesses all count. This is the halfway step to Property Mogul, so it will pop naturally on the way to owning them all.

trophies.name: Master Thief
trophies.guide: Steal 50 cars in total; the counter is cumulative and counts any car you take. It builds up fast in normal play, since missions often start with grabbing a car. If you are short, steal parked cars in a quiet street and the count climbs quickly.

trophies.name: Smooth Talker
trophies.description: Complete a mission without being detected.
trophies.guide: Complete any stealth-capable mission without raising an alarm or being spotted. Move slowly, use cover, take down enemies quietly and avoid the detection cones. If you are spotted, restart from the checkpoint and try again; the trophy pops at the mission's end if you stayed undetected.

trophies.name: Unstoppable
trophies.guide: Find a rampage pickup (the skull icon) and complete its kill quota before the timer runs out. Heavy weapons and the minigun make it much easier. The trophy pops when the rampage ends with the quota met.

trophies.name: Treasure Hunter
trophies.guide: Pick up any hidden package in Leonida. The easiest early one sits on the Vice Beach boardwalk area; listen for the faint chime and look for the glowing package. The trophy pops on the first pickup, and it is the first step toward Collector.

trophies.name: Vice City Nights
trophies.description: Watch the sunset from the Vice City boardwalk.
trophies.guide: Stand on the Vice City boardwalk at sunset and watch until the sun drops below the horizon. Be there between 18:00 and 19:30 in-game time, face the ocean, and wait. The trophy pops once the sunset sequence completes.

trophies.name: Sun Chaser
trophies.guide: Watch 10 sunsets anywhere in Leonida; the counter is cumulative. Just be outside and facing the horizon as the sun sets. It builds up naturally over a long playthrough, and the boardwalk is a reliable spot.

trophies.name: Full Tank
trophies.guide: Drive into any gas station and fill the tank completely. Fuel is a new GTA VI mechanic: the gauge drains as you drive, and a full fill costs a few hundred dollars. The trophy pops when the pump stops at full.

trophies.name: Sticky Fingers
trophies.guide: Pickpocket 10 pedestrians in total. Walk up behind someone in a crowd and use the steal prompt; busy streets in Vice City are the best hunting ground. Getting caught raises your wanted level, so pick quiet targets and walk away calmly after each one.

trophies.name: Bounty Hunter
trophies.guide: Take a bounty mission from the bounty board and bring the target in. Bounties appear after the story opens the bounty system; follow the target, subdue them and deliver them alive for the full payout. The trophy pops on delivery.

trophies.name: Kingpin
trophies.description: Build your criminal empire to level 10.
trophies.guide: Raise your criminal empire rank to level 10 by running businesses, completing empire missions and laundering money. Empire rank grows with income and completed operations, so keep your businesses stocked and running. The trophy pops when the rank hits 10.

trophies.name: Big Shot
trophies.guide: Earn a cumulative $1,000,000 across all income: story payouts, heists, businesses and side work. The big heists alone push you most of the way there, and property income tops it up. Check the Stats page to see your lifetime earnings.

trophies.name: Making Moves
trophies.guide: Complete any 10 side missions: Strangers & Freaks, bounties, taxi work, deliveries and other odd jobs all count. The counter is cumulative, so it pops naturally as you explore. The map's side-activity icons show what is available nearby.

trophies.name: Leonida Explorer
trophies.guide: Set foot in every district of the map: Vice City, Vice Beach, the Port, the swamps, the northern forests, the islands and the smaller towns. Driving through counts, but you must enter the district's boundary. The map greys out districts you have not visited yet, so sweep the map and fill it in.
